I replied in the thread: the discount is 10%. Bettina's 12% post on Nov 17 was a misread, and she corrected it to 10% four minutes later in the same channel.

I didn't put the renewal price or the contract details in the thread, since those are finance terms. For the brief, the 2026 renewal order form (signed June 18, 2026) carries the 10% forward unchanged. Anyone who needs the exact terms should get them from June Osei-Lark on the deal desk.
